# cloudsigma_capabilities (Data Source)

Reads the deployment-specific CloudSigma capabilities document. The JSON field is dynamic and account/location scoped.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity for the current capabilities document.
- `json` (String) The complete dynamic capabilities document as canonical JSON.
